summary: Resolves the locale/codepage name for a CPInfo object: when a1 is a valid object belonging to the module byte_5B94D4 and matching the vtable off_5B94D0, the name string is extracted directly with sub_587ECE(a1). Otherwise the locale is queried through the function pointer dword_8D3FB8 (parameter dword_8D3FB4, message 11 or 4100, 8-byte buffer) and, on success, the name is extracted from that buffer; a failed query propagates a 0 return.

local_names.v1: byte pointer into the CPInfo object or the query result buffer
local_names.v3: 8-byte stack buffer holding the locale query result
local_names.result: locale query return value (0 signals failure)

operations.description: Set v1 = a1 as the byte pointer into the CPInfo object.
Take the CPInfo path only when a1 is non-null, its first byte (this:0x0) is non-zero, and sub_58FB90(a1, byte_5B94D4) reports the object belongs to the module identified by byte_5B94D4.
Membership test against the vtable: sub_58FB90(a1, &off_5B94D0) checks whether the object is the CPInfo vtable entry.
When the object matches the vtable off_5B94D0, extract and return the name string directly with sub_587ECE(a1).
CPInfo fallback: query the locale via dword_8D3FB8(dword_8D3FB4, 11, v3, 8) into the 8-byte stack buffer.
Else branch (invalid CPInfo object): query the locale via dword_8D3FB8(dword_8D3FB4, 4100, v3, 8).
If the locale query returns 0, propagate the failure by returning 0 immediately.
Repoint v1 to the stack buffer v3 filled by the successful locale query.
Extract the null-terminated name string from the buffer with sub_587ECE(v1) and return it.
Called by sub_58FD90 (0x0058FD90) to resolve the codepage/locale name during locale setup.
